scope: Browser voice reply behavior; no paid provider calls

expected: question is sent without a click
Siri orb appears only during playback
one unlocked audio context serves both turns
cases.test: hands-free sends on a pause, speaks with the orb, then listens for the next turn
hands-free silence times out without transcribing or sending
ending hands-free during transcription discards a late transcript
switching chats ends hands-free and prevents a late reply from restarting it
typing or hiding the tab ends hands-free recording
a speech error ends hands-free instead of silently reopening the microphone

expected: audio is prepared from the Send gesture
only the completed reply is spoken
cases.test: a voice-submitted question reads its completed reply, while the next typed question stays silent

actions: type and send a new question
expected: the new typed question does not trigger narration
the manual speaker action remains available
cases.test: a voice-submitted question reads its completed reply, while the next typed question stays silent
stopping a voice-triggered reply cancels its queued narration and closes prepared audio

expected: no narration leaks into the new chat
cases.test: switching chats drops a queued voice reply

expected: replacement is treated as typed input
cases.test: clearing a dictated draft restores manual playback for typed questions
